Another example from old job: We were interviewing a candidate for an internship. He put down a 3.9 GPA on his resume, and did OK at interviews. We offered him the position, he accepted. Sure, there are things you have to do. And sometimes, you can get away with not doing things you "have" to do. Ultimately, we're all responsible for the consequences of our own actions.
